drivingQuestion: Why is the sciatic nerve not nullified by the majority of permitted sinews it was cooked with?
outcomeNote: The unit consists of the lemma and the difficulty only; the answer (בריה שאני) falls in the next unit.

segments.en: § The mishna states (96b): With regard to «a sciatic nerve that was cooked» with other sinews, when one identifies the sciatic nerve and removes it, the other sinews are forbidden if the sciatic nerve was large enough to impart flavor. And if he does not identify it, all the sinews are forbidden because each one could be the sciatic nerve. The Gemara challenges: «Let» the sciatic nerve «be nullified by» a simple «majority.»
